note: Integer rupees everywhere -- no floats, no toFixed. price <= mrp. The discount percentage is DERIVED, never stored. `new`, `sale`, `low-stock` and `sold-out` are DERIVED too: `badges` holds only what a human chose. Variants carry `delta`, never a price, and ONLY THE SIZE AXIS may carry a non-zero one -- for a garment that is real: XL and XXL take more cloth. `swatch` is a literal hex and is the one permitted literal colour in this project -- it is product data, not theme, and tokens.pl never sees it because tokens.pl reads only styles/*.css. `sizeChart` names a chart in shop.json; data.pl fails if the chart is missing or does not cover every size this product sells. A product with no `img` key renders generated artwork from art.js; adding `img` is the photography swap path. PRICES AND PRODUCTS ARE ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT REAL -- see shop.json placeholder. Three products is the skeleton, not the shop.

products.desc: A dobby weave gives the cloth a fine raised grid you can see from a foot away and feel at once — it is woven in, not printed on. Cut regular through the chest with a slight taper at the waist, so it sits under a jacket without bunching and still looks right untucked. The same shirting we run for two export labels; this one carries our own name.

products.desc: Hand-blocked in Bagru in madder and iron black, on a cotton that has already been washed once so it will not shrink away from the size you chose. Straight cut, side slits to mid-thigh, and a length that works over leggings or trousers. The print sits a little unevenly from panel to panel, which is what a wooden block does and a roller never would.
